text:
oliver.partnerships: Quick sync request 8 can we align owners for the tri-platform integration: Snowflake connector + Databricks runtime validation + Qdrant vector compatibility + Lambda hardware pilot. Need marketplace listing checklist + SI enablement + partner press timing.
maya_product: Proposed cut: docs/code freeze 05/02, partner final sign-off 05/10, public listing 05/17. Gives partners one week for legal/brand signoff. Thoughts?
kevin_eng: Freeze on 05/02 is OK if we prune the connector scope: only schema mapping + incremental ingest + vector write. Skip backfill tooling for v1. We'll need 3 dev sprints for Databricks runtime matrix coverage.
lisa_infra: Lambda hardware pilot: our testbed runs on CUDA 12 / cudNN 9. I need to add a Databricks-compatible container build and validate interop with older kernels customers might use. Estimate 6 days to extend CI.
noah_sales: Partner ops ask: we must include partner-approved marketplace copy + 2 co-branded assets and a joint FAQ by listing date. Also want a short customer POV slide comparing cloud vs on-prem TCO.
sophie_ops: I'll own marketplace runbook (rollback steps, semantic version pinning, and telemetry hooks). Will also set the post-launch on-call schedule.
kevin_eng: Quick local test I ran against Qdrant 1.6:
```
# simple ingest + query smoke
python -m redwood.connectors.snowflake sync --source s3://sampledata --dest qdrant://localhost:6333/collections/test
curl -s localhost:6333/collections/test | jq .points_count
```
kevin_eng: At 50k vectors we saw ~300ms median but 2-3s tail on CPU-only worker. Batching and async writes reduced tail to ~600ms. Need to capture those knobs in the compatibility doc.
lisa_infra: I'll run Lambda perf with batch sizes [4,16,64], warm KV cache, and compare FP16 vs int8 quant profile. ETA 05/01 for initial table.
maya_product: Who's writing the KMS/HSM integration notes for on-prem? That's a blocker for enterprise partners.
oliver.partnerships: Maya assign to kevin_eng for the integration spec and to sophie_ops for deployment notes. I'll coordinate partner reviews.
noah_sales: Can engineering produce one slide showing latency/cost tradeoff across the three setups (hosted / dedicated / lambda-onprem)? We need it for partner briefing.
ekeep: (typo)
kevin_eng: Yep I'll produce that chart as part of perf report.
ci-bot: CI: integration-matrix triggered by kevin_eng  job id 5432 (cuda12 / runtime-13 / qdrant-1.6).
sophie_ops: Action items recap: 1) Kevin 5 engineering specs + perf slide by 05/01; 2) Lisa 5 CI + lambda perf table by 05/01; 3) Maya 5 timeline + PR milestones by 04/28; 4) Sophie 5 marketplace runbook by 05/08; 5) Oliver 5 partner sync invite.
oliver.partnerships: Thanks all. I'll schedule a partner dry-run for Tue 09:30 PT. I'll post invite and partner doc links.
noah_sales: +1 Tue 09:30.
kevin_eng: Uploaded preliminary compat doc: https://redwood.app/drive/partners/tri-platform-compat-v1 (ping for access).
maya_product: Closing for now 5 will open a shared PR tracker and milestone board. :rocket:
